Name: Eye of the Beholder - Fantasy Farm Animals
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][size=5][b][u]Eye of the Beholder[/u][/b][/size][/center]


[size=4]Bring something a little more unsettling to your barn.

This mod adds a Beholder as a new barn animal in Stardew Valley, complete with its own discovery event, custom products, artisan goods, progression, and questline.

Your first Beholder isn’t bought from Marnie. Instead, you’ll encounter a mysterious creature within the Ginger Island Volcano where it offers you an unusual proposition—and a very unusual egg.

Raise the creature, learn how to care for it, and slowly convince the people of Stardew Valley that keeping an otherworldly monster in your barn is a perfectly reasonable farming decision.[/size]

[size=5][u]Features[/u][/size]
[size=4]A new Beholder barn animal [/size]
[size=4]New animal products and artisan goods
Beholder Eggs can be hatched in an Ostrich Incubator.[/size]
[size=4]3 Unique colors to unlock[/size]
[size=4]
[u]Beholders produce:[/u]
Beholder Milk
Beholder Eggs
Rare gems upon full friendship (so shiny)[/size]
[size=4]
[u]Custom artisan goods:[/u]
Beholder Milk → Beholder Cheese
Beholder Egg → Beholder Mayonnaise
[i]**Each artisan good has a unique buff**[/i][/size]
[size=4]
A short progression questline involving Marnie and Marlon.[/size]

[size=5][u]Quest Progression[/u][/size]

[size=4]Includes a small story arc that develops as you raise your first Beholder:

An Unusual Beholder
Marnie tries to figure out what, exactly, you’ve brought home.

Too Many Eyes
Marlon takes a more cautious approach.

A Question of Husbandry
Help Marnie understand Beholder care and unlock Beholders for purchase.

Something in the Milk
Marlon investigates the creature’s artisan products.

The Moonstone
A rare gift from a fully bonded Beholder raises even more questions.[/size]

[size=5][u]Requirements[/u][/size]
[size=4]
SMAPI
Content Patcher
Extra Animal Config[/size]
[size=4]Button's Extra Trigger Action Stuff (BETAS)[/size]

[size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size]

[size=4]It should be compatible with most farm, animal, and visual mods.[/size]

[size=4]Frequently Asked Questions[/size]
[size=4]Q: Is this mod made with any AI?[/size]
[size=4]A: No. Each pixel was placed by me. No code was written with AI. [/size]

[size=4]Q: Do I...have to drink the beholder mayonnaise?[/size]
[size=4]A: Only if you want the buff you coward.[/size]

[size=4]Q: You know what would be cool?[/size]
[size=4]A: I'm all ears...or eyes.....? [/size]

[size=4]Q: Can I translate this mod?[/size]
[size=4]A: Absolutely[/size]

[size=5][b]***SPOILER***[/b][/size]

[size=4]The first Beholder must be obtained through the Ginger Island Volcano event. You cannot purchase one from Marnie until completing her quest.

After raising your first Beholder and completing Marnie’s husbandry quest, additional Beholders become available for purchase.

Beholder Eggs must be incubated in an Ostrich Incubator.[/size]
